subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu support a documented inbound attachment-content opt-out, and should that policy be Feishu-specific or part of a shared channel media policy?
rationale: The reported key is not current or shipped Feishu schema, so implementing it adds config/default surface and changes attachment ingestion behavior rather than repairing an established setting.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current media downloads and switches inbound files to placeholder-only context when enabled.

options.title: Design Shared Media Policy
options.body: Create a cross-channel attachment-ingestion policy so Feishu aligns with other channel controls instead of adding another one-off setting name.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Clarify that Feishu currently supports media size limits but not file-content ignore behavior, leaving attachment downloads as intended behavior.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current media downloads and switches inbound files to placeholder-only context when enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the clearest recent history on Feishu media support and Feishu docs that would be affected by the decision.
